title: New publication in CMI!
excerpt: The key to guideline-driven antibiotic stewardship is knowing which infection was actually being treated. Martijn Siepel, together Suzanne Kuijpers and colleagues at Amsterdam UMC, we reviewed 157 studies on how the indication for antibiotic treatment is captured — and why rule-based or AI approaches remain almost untouched.

title: Publication in JPI!
excerpt: We published in JPI on automating Palga thesaurus annotations with T5-based models, showing strong quantitative gains with PaTh5.NL while highlighting persistent challenges on complex reports.
